Inside Macintosh: Telephony /
Chapter 5 - Telephone Manager Messages / Telephone Manager Message Reference
Constants

Hold States

The value parameter of the telCAHoldMsg message (page 5-19) contains one of the following constants. 
enum {
   telHoldCleared          = 0,
   telHoldEst              = 1,
   telHoldFailed           = 2
};
Constant descriptions
telHoldCleared
A held call was retrieved.
telHoldEst
The call was put on hold.
telHoldFailed
The attempt to put the call on hold failed.
